Hackaethon (Hackathon) entry

### What does this PR do?

This PR adds support for the [Brotli](https://brotli.org/) compression algorithm to Traefik.

Some breaking changes:

- a new functionality is that if a request's `Accept-Encoding` header is set to `*`, a compressed response will now be sent, instead of the previous non-compressed response. Brotli is used when `*` is set because the gzip library used seems to ignore it.

- Also, If the Accept-Encoding request header is absent, it is meant as b…

requested. If it is present, but its value is the empty string, then compression is disabled.

Fixes #4202

### Motivation

This was a suggested issue for the [Traefik Proxy 3.0 Hackaethon](https://traefik.io/blog/announcing-traefik-proxy-3-0-hackaethon/). It looked achievable with my schedule.
